decision: no waiting window is adopted as ground truth without benchmark-aligned coverage and validation

literature_assessment.finding: waiting-time clean labels are observed labels and may be noisy; shorter waits mislabeled defect-inducing changes as clean by up to 45.86%
literature_assessment.source: Song and Minku, Empirical Software Engineering 2023

literature_assessment.finding: a 15-day online waiting window is operational, not proof of defect-free ground truth, and late fixes create false negatives
literature_assessment.source: Liu et al., Science of Computer Programming 2025
